capabilities: , Insert images and drawings from a visual grid.
Insert assets into notes, Excalidraw, and Mappy.
extras: WebP conversion is disabled on iOS. Deletion is one file at a time and only when no reference is detected. Requires Obsidian's Files & Links → Automatically update internal links to be on for renaming and moving.
problem: Users often struggle to manage and locate visual assets within a vault without relying on complex folder structures or tags.

relations.evidence: For Mappy, the mind map plugin by Hiroya Iizuka (desktop only, like Mappy itself).

requires.name: Files & Links → Automatically update internal links

summary: A visual asset picker that allows users to insert images and Excalidraw drawings into notes, Excalidraw, and Mappy mind maps, automatically grouping files by filename prefix.
